sections.Profile:
"Oklahoma" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by United Manufacturing Company in June 1949. The game features two flippers, four pop bumpers, and six kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: United Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1949
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
